systems.system: Education Management and Information System (EMIS) / annual school census
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and Scientific Research (MENRS)
systems.tiers: annual school census: paper collection at the school, electronic entry at central level; private schools covered; published as statistical yearbooks and spreadsheets

systems.system: Human resources module for the EMIS

note: The EMIS is described only as an annual school census, paper at the school and keyed centrally, so it is class census and gives no fact; the paper statement is about the census return, not learners' records. For dpi.exchange: the report (19 December 2023) says the EMIS is not yet integrated with human resources, infrastructure or examinations data.
